app.name: Burnout 3 (recompiled)
app.long_description:
Unofficial, non-commercial fan project. Burnout 3: Takedown is a trademark of Electronic Arts; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed by EA or Criterion. No game assets are included: you must supply your own legally owned copy.
Burnout 3: Takedown (PS2, NTSC-U) recompiled for the Wii.
Needs your own copy of the game as burnout3.iso in this folder, or in burnout3/ on the SD card or a FAT32/NTFS USB drive (data and app may be split; see README.txt). GameCube controller or Classic Controller.
run.log in the data folder is the log; with the console test's auto.txt it also holds the race benchmark ("bench:" line) and prof.bin, a profile of the race start. Delete auto.txt to play normally.
Credits: PCSX2, Dolphin, PS2SDK, extrems/libntfs, NTFS-3G, libchdr/MAME and devkitPro/libogc. Full list in CREDITS.md.
